answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using latency tomography across a verification bridge. Agents must answer synchronized timing challenges from beacons that measure arrival delta across network paths. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of leasing dispersed physical links, preventing a single server from being able to harbor multiple synthetic identities. However, this mechanism penalizes agents on high-jitter links and cannot stop spoofing via residential proxy networks.
